records.subject: Welcome aboard, Pioneer Collective
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Pioneer Collective* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Project created on day 1 (2026-06-09) shows real intent and kickoff was held [calendar:b1537916], but Owen hasn't replied to two outreach emails [email:6cf6dee5, email:ec97733f], no invites sent, and no key milestone in 6 days. 8 days left; momentum appears to have stalled after setup.

draft.subject: Next step on your first project
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff last week — good to see your first project up in Wrenfield already. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks there is usually the easiest next move.

When you're ready to bring the rest of the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's most useful.

Best,
Nadia
